RAMP IN TALKS TO RAISE $1B+ AT MORE THAN $70B VALUATION
articles.summary: Ramp is in early discussions to raise at least $1 billion at a valuation above $70 billion, which would be its third funding round in a year and more than double its valuation over that period. The rapid fundraising reflects continued investor demand for Ramp as it expands beyond corporate cards into AI-powered expense management and broader financial software.

articles.title: BILT SEEKS $18B VALUATION AS IT EXPANDS BEYOND RENT REWARDS
articles.summary: Bilt is seeking to raise $500 million at an $18 billion valuation, up more than 60% from the $10.8 billion valuation it reached last year. The company is using the new capital to expand beyond rent rewards and build a broader neighborhood-based rewards platform.

articles.title: TPG TO TAKE BILL PRIVATE IN $6B DEAL WITH CORPAY
articles.summary: TPG and Corpay agreed to acquire BILL Holdings for about $6 billion in cash, offering $63.25 per share, a 31% premium to BILL's 60-day volume-weighted average price before takeover reports emerged. Corpay will invest $1.1 billion for roughly one-third of BILL and retain an option to buy the rest in 2030, while the deal follows activist pressure, workforce cuts, and intensifying competition in SMB financial software.

articles.title: INTUIT SELLS MAILCHIMP TO BENDING SPOONS FOR $3.68B
articles.summary: Intuit agreed to sell Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for $3.68 billion, less than one-third of the $12 billion it paid for the email-marketing company in 2021. The sale marks a major retreat from Intuit's push beyond tax and accounting software, as Mailchimp revenue declined 1% and became a drag on growth, while Bending Spoons continues its strategy of acquiring former high-growth software assets at sharply reduced valuations.

articles.title: MORE BANKS SAY CUSTOMERS USING AI AGENTS ARE ON THEIR OWN — EVEN IF THEY GET HACKED
articles.summary: Citi's updated agreement treats actions by an AI agent granted account access as authorized, including actions that exceed the customer's instructions. It extends that treatment to credentials subsequently leaked by the agent, subject to applicable law. Citi exempts tools it supplies itself, creating a meaningful difference in the risks customers accept when choosing an independent financial assistant.

GIVE YOUR AGENTS CONTROLLED ACCESS TO ANALYZE YOUR DATA AND MOVE FUNDS
articles.summary: Stripe Treasury's public preview lets AI assistants pay vendors, convert currencies, and top up accounts ahead of bills or payroll. Agents connected through a user's Stripe account need confirmation for every action that moves money, while agents with their own API keys can work in the background under custom approval rules. A business could let an agent make ACH transfers under $50 automatically and route larger transfers to a designated approver.

articles.title: CHARGEBEE UNVEILS ARC: AN AGENTIC AI PLATFORM TO AUTOMATE ENTERPRISE FINANCE WORKFLOWS
articles.summary: The billing software provider is giving accounting teams a way to turn signed contracts into proposed billing setups, draft collections replies, and track how contract amendments affect recognized revenue. Teams approve proposed actions before they take effect, and citations let reviewers trace each generated value back to its source.

articles.title: ROGO RAISES $350M AT $3.75B VALUATION TO AUTOMATE FINANCE GRUNT WORK
articles.summary: Rogo Technologies is close to raising about $350 million in a round led by Bessemer Venture Partners and General Catalyst, valuing the AI startup at $3.75 billion, up from $2 billion in April. Founded by former Lazard and JPMorgan junior bankers, Rogo is building AI tools to automate repetitive work across investment banking and other finance workflows.

articles.title: ANTHROPIC CLOSES $119.5B IPO AND PRIVATE PLACEMENT
articles.summary: Anthropic closed its IPO at $83 per share, raising about $93.5 billion in gross proceeds and roughly $91.6 billion for the company, with shares beginning to trade on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT. Alongside the offering, AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, Nvidia, and TSMC invested another $26 billion in a concurrent private placement, bringing total gross proceeds across both transactions to approximately $119.5 billion.

articles.title: GTCR EXPLORES POTENTIAL TAKEOVER OF PAYMENTS FIRM GLOBAL PAYMENTS
articles.summary: GTCR already owns 16.35% of Global Payments from its Worldpay sale and is working with other private equity firms to finance a potential takeover.

articles.title: LEAKED DEUTSCHE BANK FILES SHOW $582M IN FLAGGED EPSTEIN PAYMENTS
articles.summary: Two whistleblowers copied 15M internal Deutsche Bank files and gave them to journalists, and more than 200 reporters published on Tuesday.
